art_direction.description: Hand-painted cel-polished male axe-warrior matching storybook portrait: windswept dark hair, clean-shaven handsome face, orange-red scarf, charcoal/black armor with warm copper-gold trim; single silver-bladed axe, no firearms.

registration.source_coordinates: Absolute original PNG pixels; one measured anatomy height per bank; no per-frame fitting.
registration.source_facing: front facing_x1 southeast; back facing_x-1 northwest
registration.integration: Atomic full family; root sampler rejects whole family if any bank missing or invalid.

provenance.details: All prompts, original/selected paths, actual dimensions, alpha QA and authored frame anchors are saved in the listed bank metadata JSONs.

limitations: 4 authored generic/walk keyposes per view;6 authored basic/secondary poses per view.
Source images are uncropped raw generated RGBA. Adaptive nonuniform source rectangles used where transparent gutters do not match nominal grid.
Anatomical anchors are manual estimates; native playback, transition cadence and hit-contact alignment are required runtime checks.
